svg.title: Bayline Sports production architecture
svg.desc: Fans reach a Next.js application through Route 53 DNS and Caddy HTTPS on AWS Lightsail. An independent Node.js worker polls BALLDONTLIE, official NBA broadcast schedules and official YouTube channels, validates data and writes private PostgreSQL snapshots. The browser refreshes cached APIs every 15 seconds. Off-server backups, an independent readiness monitor and a CodeBuild to ECR release path support operations.
svg.text: A cached sports dashboard with independent ingestion, private storage and verified recovery.
Web, worker and PostgreSQL run as separate services.
Provider keys stay in the worker; its schedule survives web restarts.
CloudWatch + SNS report failure and recovery
Worker, score-feed, backup and restore checks
Notifications are not a spending cutoff
15s browser refresh reads the database cache. Warriors networks poll every 15m; upstream failures use backoff.
Warriors broadcast sync is live. Other leagues retain reviewed viewing links. Production verified October 26, 2026.
